recentItems.description:
Seth Meyers and A Closer Look supervising writer/producer Sal Gentile discuss the news they're missing while Late Night is on summer hiatus. In this episode they discuss Republicans avoiding Trump's midterm convention, the ongoing drama over "Lake America," Trump pushing AI data centers and a USPS whistleblower complaint about Trump's plan to restrict mail-in ballots.
